thread:
maria: spotted ~1.5k DB snapshot objects in prod missing SSE headers under redwood-db-snapshots/snapshots/2026-05-03/ — no x-amz-server-side-encryption present.
security-bot: [alert] object-store:missing-sse detected for prefix snapshots/2026-05-03/ (alert AS-2026-718) — https://alerts.redwood.internal/AS-2026-718
aj: paste of HEAD from one object shows Content-Length and x-amz-meta-origin but SSE header absent.
maria: sample HEAD:
```
Content-Length: 314572800
x-amz-meta-origin: backup-service
x-amz-server-side-encryption: <absent>
```
luca: we pushed a small uploader metadata rewrite last night (PR #5299). It changed when metadata is attached after multipart complete — possible race.
aj: CloudTrail shows 1,512 PutObject/CompleteMultipartUpload calls for that prefix between 02:07-02:32Z by role arn:aws:iam::0123456789:role/svc-uploader-role. No kms:GrantTokens present in the call context.
erin: compliance: this could be reportable depending on customer SLAs. Need a precise timeline and affected tenant list.
sam-oncall: immediate mitigation: options are revoke PutObject for svc-uploader-role or add a bucket policy denying PutObject when s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption != aws:kms. I can push a targeted deny to the snapshots prefix now.
luca: bucket policy fragment (deny when SSE header missing or not aws:kms):
```
"Condition": { "StringNotEquals": { "s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms" } }
```
But that will break any legacy writers; prefer short revoke + patch.
aj: I'm exporting affected keys and mapping tenants; will attach CSV to the incident doc.
maria: remediation proposal:
- stop further unencrypted writes (sam-oncall)
- re-encrypt by copying objects with metadata-directive REPLACE + --sse aws:kms for a sample (luca)
- validate checksums and multipart ETags (aj)
- notify CS/Legal with tenant list (erin)

luca: quick re-encrypt command I tested (dry-run):
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-db-snapshots/snapshots/2026-05-03/snap-0001 \
  s3://redwood-db-snapshots/snapshots/2026-05-03/snap-0001 \
  --metadata-directive REPLACE --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/redwood-cmk
```
Note: multipart objects need multipart-copy to avoid corrupting ETag semantics.
aj: re-encrypt will incur GET+PUT; for ~1.5k objects it's acceptable. Will record pre/post ETag and sizes.
maria: also check replication and whether any of these were already mirrored elsewhere — aj?
aj: checked CRR status: none of the affected keys show replication enabled. Good.
erin: draft notification template ready; will wait for CSV to mark who needs to be notified.
sam-oncall: applied temporary deny policy to snapshots/2026-05-03/* at 03:48Z and revoked PutObject for svc-uploader-role pending fix.
luca: hotfix: reverting metadata rewrite so SSE is set before multipart completion + adding unit/integration test. Canary to staging in 10m.
maria: follow-ups for postmortem:
- add bucket-level deny for missing SSE on all snapshot prefixes
- add CloudTrail Athena alert for PutObject without x-amz-server-side-encryption
- revert ephemeral KMS grant TTL experiment until uploader stability proven
- update encryptops runbook for unencrypted upload incidents

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-718 created, severity=P1, responders=@maria @aj @luca @sam-oncall @erin
aj: uploaded CSV (object_key,size,put_timestamp,uploader_principal) to incident page and started checksum validation on a sample.
luca: staging canary looks good; ready to roll hotfix to prod and start bulk re-encrypt job after approval.
erin: CS notified for customers with pending restores per contract obligations.
maria: thanks team. keep incident doc updated with validation and re-encrypt progress. :thumbsup:
